messages:
Jordan (CSM): @Maria FYI Emberly AI asked to onboard a private reranker (13B quantized) behind VPC + HSM. They said the model will see clinical notes with PHI. Can we kick off intake?
Maria (Customer Success): Got it — marking high priority. Do we have the model artifact or evals yet? They said private (not hosted).
Jordan (CSM): Private deployment. They want HSM with FIPS, monthly commit, target 50 qps peak and ~0.8s p50. Go-live requested by Apr 15.
Lee (ML Eng): Need artifact details: HF repo or tarball, exact parameter count, and whether quantized artifact is provided. Also we require safety evals: hallucination checks, PHI-leak tests, and a red-team prompt suite.
Sam (Solutions Eng): I'll size infra. Quick Q: strictly VPC or on-prem option later? Also send customer to the onboarding checklist: https://redwood.internal/onboard-checklist
Jordan (CSM): VPC initially; on-prem might come later. Renewal upsell is in May so timeline is tight — if we slip, renewal could be at risk.
Maria (Customer Success): Noted. I'll coordinate with AM for renewal escalation if needed and set an enablement + runbook session.
OpsBot: New ticket created: CS-4821 Onboard Emberly AI private reranker. Assigned: Sam, Lee, Maria. ETA initial intake 48h.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Do they plan to provide int8 quantized artifact or want Redwood to quantize? If they provide int8 we can validate and save time.
Jordan (CSM): They can provide an int8 tarball; asked us to validate. They'll upload to our secure bucket. I'll send temporary S3 write creds.
Lee (ML Eng): For model QA send: held-out query set (~5k), relevance labels, latency SLOs, and a safety prompt-suite (PHI redaction and hallucination scenarios). We'll run A/B vs our baseline and produce a quality/regression report.
Maria (Customer Success): I'll collect the PHI/PII questionnaire and legal signoffs. Also confirm HSM key rotation and KMS policy.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Draft infra suggestion: 4x A100-80GB for baseline latency; fallback plan for Dedicated if private needs more time. I'll run simulation with their sequence length distribution.
Jordan (CSM): Scheduling an enablement call tomorrow 10:00am PT with Dana from Emberly. @Sam can you create the calendar invite?
Maria (Customer Success): Invite sent with agenda: intake checklist, artifact upload instructions, security reqs, timeline & SLAs. Recording will be saved to the account workspace.
Lee (ML Eng): Heads up — if quantization format mismatches our runtime we may need to rebuild/quantize which is +2 weeks.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Noted. Preparing fallback: serve a compatible 13B baseline on Dedicated until private pass is green.
Jordan (CSM): I'm pushing for artifact upload today. I'll post the S3 path when done. Example upload path I asked them to use:
```
s3://redwood-secure/emberly/artifacts/13b/int8.tar.gz
```
Maria (Customer Success): I'll also capture feedback on their eval expectations so we can align success metrics for renewal.
OpsBot: Ticket CS-4821 updated: intake call scheduled; status = waiting for artifacts.
Jordan (CSM): Thanks team — will follow up after the call. :thumbsup:
